title: City status and region
description: Davao City is a highly urbanized city in the Davao Region (Region XI).

title: Barangays and districts
description: Davao City has 182 barangays, 3 legislative districts, and 11 administrative districts.
notes: The cited PSA source supports the barangay count; confirm district counts on a PSA or city page.

title: Population in the 2020 census
description: The 2020 Census of Population and Housing figure supplied for Davao City is 1,776,949.
notes: PSA highlights page states this figure; read the page and confirm before verifying.

title: Land area
description: The land-area figure supplied for Davao City is 2,443.61 square kilometers.
notes: source needed: PSA population density table (Table A)

title: Most populous barangay in Region XI in 2020
description: Bucana is the most populous barangay in Region XI in 2020, with 80,538 residents.
notes: PSA highlights page states this; read and confirm before verifying.

title: 2024 POPCEN population counts declared official
description: A 2024 Census of Population (POPCEN) exists, and its population counts were declared official.
notes: A secondary list gives a different 2024 figure for Davao City; read the PSA page for the official number before adding it.

title: Administrative district names
description: The listed administrative districts are Poblacion, Talomo, Agdao, Buhangin, Bunawan, Paquibato, Baguio, Calinan, Marilog, Toril, and Tugbok.
notes: Names supplied from a city business bureau announcement; confirm against an official district list.
